title: OpenAI · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 变更日志新增 GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast 模式（通过 service_tier 参数启用）和 Agents API 的 computer use 功能，同时移除 ChatGPT Work 相关旧条目，表明功能重心从企业工作区转向 Agent 能力。

added_lines: Add events to your MCP server (optional)

Added Ultrafast mode for GPT-6 Astra in the Responses API. Use gpt-6-astra with service_tier: "ultrafast" to reduce the time between generated output tokens. It is available to API customers, subject to rate limits, with global processing and US data residency. EU and other regional inference residency aren't supported. See Ultrafast pricing.
Added computer use to the Agents API. Agents can complete tasks in an OpenAI-hosted browser, with website access approvals and sign-in handled by your application.
GPT-6.1 Sol also supports Multi-agent in beta. Let the model delegate work to subagents in a Responses API request.
